envelope.description: Migrate readers, remove eager source ownership and qualify cutover readiness

body.title: Migrate readers, remove eager source ownership and qualify cutover readiness
body.summary: Remove new-path eager source ownership, complete historical-reader behavior, and run focused correctness, isolation, recovery, cleanup and packaging regressions before the retained full qualification task.
acceptanceChecks: No production new-attempt path persists or reconstructs aggregate prepared source bodies; legacy derived views are untrusted migration inputs, not a fallback engine.
Two-session concurrency, cancellation, restart/recovery, tamper detection, publication and cleanup tests preserve exact scope and resource ownership with zero unintended cross-session access.
Production defaults, compiled build and source-free package smoke pass; task scheduling leaves t14 as the sole next qualification gate after t25.

tests.name: Source-light cutover regressions: historical cold requalification/rejection, no eager fallback, two-session isolation, cancel/restart/tamper/publication/cleanup, production defaults and task-order preservation.
Backend build and source-free compiled package smoke for code and design review after eager source ownership removal.
